en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a waterfront scene with a wooden pier or dock, a structure on the dock, a boat or ferry, and buildings visible in the background. The image is labeled 'SUNDSVALL. STOCKHOLMSBRYGGAN.' The reverse side shows classic early 20th-century postcard layout, Swedish text, and postage, addressed to England. There is a postage stamp from Sweden, and handwriting on both sides.
